title: National Single Emergency Number 112 (ERSS)
target_audience: All citizens needing immediate Police, Fire, Ambulance, or Disaster rescue.
benefits: Single integrated 24x7 emergency response across all states and union territories. Works even without SIM card balance, locked mobile phones, and routes GPS location automatically to the nearest emergency dispatch vehicle.
eligibility: Anyone in India facing an emergency.
how_to_apply: Dial 112 directly from any mobile phone or landline.

title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal & 1930 Helpline
target_audience: Victims of financial online fraud, unauthorized bank transfers, social media blackmail, or cyberstalking.
benefits: Immediate 'Golden Hour' financial lien/freeze on fraudulent bank accounts and UPI IDs to recover stolen funds before scammers withdraw cash.
documents_needed: Bank account number, transaction UTR number, mobile number, SMS screenshots.
how_to_apply: Call 1930 immediately within 1-2 hours of financial fraud, or file full complaint with evidence on cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Kisan Call Centre (KCC) 1800-180-1551 Free Agro-Advisory
target_audience: Farmers, fruit growers, and dairy farmers seeking free agricultural scientist consultation.
benefits: Toll-free voice call connecting directly to agricultural experts speaking your local regional dialect from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM on all 7 days.
how_to_apply: Dial 1800-180-1551 (or short code 1551) from any mobile phone.

title: Childline 1098 for Child Protection & Distress
target_audience: Children in distress, child laborers, missing children, runaway or abused minors.
benefits: 24-hour free emergency phone service for children in need of care and protection, connecting with District Child Protection Units (DCPU) and Child Welfare Committees.
eligibility: Children under 18 years of age or concerned citizens reporting child distress.
how_to_apply: Dial 1098 from any phone across India.

title: Tele-MANAS 14416 Free 24x7 Mental Health Counseling
target_audience: Individuals experiencing depression, severe anxiety, loneliness, insomnia, or emotional distress.
benefits: Completely confidential, free 24x7 psychological tele-counseling by trained mental health counselors and clinical psychiatrists in 20+ regional languages.
how_to_apply: Dial 14416 or 1800-891-4416 toll-free from any mobile or landline.

title: India Post Tracking, Speed Post & Rural Post Office Savings
target_audience: Citizens sending parcels, speed post letters, or seeking secure post office recurring deposits.
benefits: Reliable last-mile delivery to every village pin code in India, SMS tracking alerts, Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS), and Kisan Vikas Patra.
documents_needed: Consignment tracking number (13 alphanumeric characters) for package tracking.
how_to_apply: Track articles online on indiapost.gov.in or visit local Branch Post Office (BPO).

title: e-RaktKosh National Blood Bank Stock Availability & 104
target_audience: Patients and hospital attendants requiring emergency blood units or platelets.
benefits: Real-time verification of blood group stock availability (A+, B+, O+, AB+, etc.) across licensed government and Red Cross blood banks in every district.
eligibility: All patients with doctor's blood requisition slip.
documents_needed: Patient hospital requisition slip and donor replacement card if available.
how_to_apply: Search live stock on eraktkosh.in or call state health helpline 104.

title: Rail Madad 139 All-in-One Railway Inquiry & Grievance
target_audience: Train passengers needing PNR status, train running status, clean coach request, or medical emergency on train.
benefits: Single interactive voice response (IVR) and live agent assistance for all railway queries: PNR, arrival/departure delays, coach cleaning, wheelchair at station, and security assistance.
how_to_apply: Dial 139 from any mobile phone or send SMS to 139.

title: National Poisons Information Centre (NPIC) - AIIMS New Delhi
target_audience: Cases of accidental ingestion of pesticide, household chemicals, rat poison, snake bite, or poisonous plants.
benefits: Immediate clinical emergency toxicological guidance on antidotes, first aid, gastric lavage protocols, and hospital stabilization for doctors and public.
documents_needed: Name or bottle of consumed chemical/pesticide.
how_to_apply: Call 1800-116-117 (24x7 Toll-Free NPIC AIIMS) immediately while shifting patient to nearest ICU.

title: UIDAI Aadhaar 1947 Toll-Free All-Language Helpline
target_audience: Citizens with queries on Aadhaar generation, PVC card delivery, update status, or demographic mismatch.
benefits: Interactive voice guidance and live executive support in 12 Indian languages regarding enrolment ID status, nearest Aadhaar center, and OTP delivery troubleshooting.
how_to_apply: Dial 1947 (toll-free) from any mobile or landline phone.
